ValidationRule.description: Short notice is blocked at intake. Scheduled and completed requests are exempt so fulfilment can run on the effective date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Cancellation"), NOT(ISBLANK(Cancellation_Effective_Date__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Awaiting_Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved") ), Cancellation_Effective_Date__c < DATEVALUE(TEXT(TODAY()+30)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The cancellation effective date must be at least 30 days from today.
